questions: Are the cars within each set equally spaced initially, or can they be arbitrarily positioned as long as they are far apart and moving in the same direction?
Do we count collisions that occur simultaneously (e.g., multiple cars meeting at the same point and time) as separate collisions or as one event?
Is the speed constant and identical for all cars, and if so, is it exactly 1 unit per time unit or unspecified?
Should the function return the total number of collisions over all time, or the number of collisions occurring at a specific instant (e.g., maximum simultaneous collisions)?
Are the cars considered point objects, or do they have non-zero length that could affect whether they 'meet'?
Does 'very far from each other' imply that all left-to-right cars start to the left of all right-to-left cars, or could they be interleaved initially?
Is the road one-dimensional, and are cars allowed to occupy the same point without interacting beyond the defined collision?
Should collisions between cars moving in the same direction (e.g., rear-end) be considered, or only between opposite-direction cars?
